{{Cryptics
|clue = [[Clue scroll (master) - A chisel and hammer reside in his home, strange for one of magic|A chisel and hammer reside in his home, strange for one of magic. Impress him with your magical equipment.]]
|note = [[Wizard Cromperty]] at the north-east corner of [[East Ardougne]]. Speak to him while wearing [[equipment]] adding up to at least +100 in [[magical]] attack bonus. |level = 5}}

|level = 5}}

{{Cryptics
|clue=''Buried beneath the ground, who knows where it's found.''

''Lucky for you, A man called Jorral may have a clue.''
|note=Speak to [[Jorral]] to receive a [[strange device]], which works similarly to the [[enchanted key]] (must have [[Making History]] quest completed).

For a list of all possible locations, see [[Treasure Trails/Guide/Hot Cold|here]].
|task=hotcold
|image=Cryptic clue - speak to Jorral.png
|level= 5}}
{{Cryptics
|clue=[[Clue scroll (master) - Come brave adventurer, your sense is on fire|Come brave adventurer, your sense is on fire. If you talk to me, it's an old god you desire.]]
|note=Speak to [[Viggora]]. Note that he can be found (is visible) in 3 locations, but you can only speak to (and continue the clue) the version of him that you spoke to during [[Curse of the Empty Lord]] [[miniquest]]. You can check your quest log to find out which location. 
*[[Paddewwa]], [[Edgeville Dungeon]], near the [[earth warrior]]s.
*{{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Rogues' Castle]] in the deep [[Wilderness]].
*{{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Canifis]] [[Slayer Tower]], just before the [[Infernal Mage]].

A [[ring of visibility]] or a [[ring of shadows]] and [[ghostspeak amulet]] are required to make progress through the clue.
|task=talk
|image=Cryptic clue - talk to Viggora.png
|level=5}}

|task=talk

{{Cryptics
|clue=[[Clue scroll (master) - If you're feeling brave, dig beneath the dragon's eye|If you're feeling brave, dig beneath the dragon's eye.]]
|note=Dig below the mossy rock under the [[Viyeldi caves]]. Requires progress or completion of [[Legends' Quest]]. 

If the quest has not been completed, a [[bravery potion]] and rope is required. 

If the player has 91 [[Agility]]{{Boostable|yes}}, they can purchase a [[long rope]] from the [[Darkmeyer General Store]] and attach it to [[Rocks (Viyeldi caves)|rocks]] and use it to avoid having to navigate the perilous slope.

If the player does not have 96 Agility{{Boostable|yes}}, a [[pickaxe]], a [[lockpick]], [[unpowered orb]], 3 [[cosmic rune]]s and 30 elemental runes of one type are additionally required to enter the [[Viyeldi caves]].
|task=dig
|image= Cryptic clue - dig dragon's eye.png
|level=5}}
{{Cryptics
|clue=[[Clue scroll (master) - I lie beneath the first descent to the holy encampment|I lie beneath the first descent to the holy encampment.]]
|note=Dig immediately after climbing down the first set of rocks towards [[Saradomin's Encampment]] within the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. Two [[rope]]s are needed; one to enter the dungeon and another to enter Saradomin's Encampment (not required if you've used once before already). 70 [[Agility]] is also required (cannot be boosted).
|task=dig
|image=Cryptic clue - dig sara gwd.png
|level=5}}
